---
title: "Setup Overview"
---

The core setup path takes a new environment from architecture planning through a locally verified ERDDAP, load-balancer integration, and final reboot testing. Complete the chapters in the order shown below.

::: {.callout-important}
The commands use placeholders such as `YOUR_GCP_PROJECT_ID`. Review and replace every placeholder before running a command. Never apply the example Terraform configuration unchanged or connect it to another group's Terraform state.
:::

## Core deployment path

```{=html}
<div class="file-grid">

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>1. Project Architecture</h3>
    <p>Choose the serving model, identify required and optional components, assign ownership, and size the initial environment.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="architecture.html">Review the architecture</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>2. Cloud Infrastructure Setup</h3>
    <p>Provision the private VM, persistent disk, optional bucket, service accounts, IAM, networking, and snapshot policy with Terraform.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-infrastructure.html">Deploy cloud infrastructure</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>3. Accessing VMs</h3>
    <p>Connect through Identity-Aware Proxy without assigning a public IP or opening SSH to the internet.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-vm-access.html">Configure VM access</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>4. ERDDAP VM Setup</h3>
    <p>Safely initialize storage, optionally mount GCS, install ERDDAP, validate it locally, and connect it to the load balancer.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-erddap-vm.html">Build the ERDDAP server</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>5. Go-Live Checklist and Recovery Basics</h3>
    <p>Complete the minimum checks required before launch and understand when snapshots or restoration are needed later.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-migration-recovery.html">Prepare for production</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

</div>
```

## Optional processing infrastructure

ERDDAP does not require a processing VM or Cloud Run. Use these chapters only when the same group also develops or operates data-generation workflows.

```{=html}
<div class="file-grid">

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>Processing VM Setup</h3>
    <p>Optional cloud VM foundation for interactive development, reprocessing, backfills, and compute-heavy workflows.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-processing-vm.html">Configure a processing VM</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="file-card">
    <h3>Data Processing Templates</h3>
    <p>Two public, sanitized GitHub templates for Cloud Run Jobs and VM-based processing projects.</p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="gcp-templates.html">Review processing templates</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

</div>
```

The later workflow and code sections are SWFSC implementation examples. They are useful references for processing design but are not part of the ERDDAP deployment sequence.
